description: This file contains JavaScript functions for address autocompletion and dynamic state list fetching in a web application, specifically for country and state/province selection during order management.

methods.name: getCountryList
methods.description: Fetches the list of countries via AJAX and initializes autocomplete.

methods.name: callCountryAutocompleter
methods.description: Sets up autocomplete for country selection using received data.

methods.name: setKeyAsParameterAndGetStateList
methods.description: Sets selected country key and triggers fetching of associated states.

methods.name: getAssociatedStateListForAutoComplete
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of states/provinces for the selected country.

methods.name: callStateAutocompleter
methods.description: Initializes autocomplete for state/province selection based on fetched data.

methods.name: getAssociatedStateList
methods.description: Fetches and populates a dropdown with states/provinces for a given country ID.
